connectionReference.description: Connection to Gmail via Power Automate Gmail connector for fetching and filtering unread emails

labelFilters.description: Gmail labels to include (e.g. INBOX, IMPORTANT). Leave empty to fetch all unread emails.

senderFilters.description: Sender email addresses or domains to match (e.g. boss@company.com, @company.com). Leave empty to include all senders.

maxResults.description: Maximum number of emails to fetch per run

setupInstructions: 1. In Power Automate, add a new connection and search for 'Gmail'
2. Sign in with your Google account when prompted
3. Authorize the Gmail connector to read your emails and labels
4. Configure labelFilters and senderFilters in settings.json to narrow results
5. Set scheduleTime in settings.json to control when the daily routine runs
